_comment: Canonical mod activation contract (#1091, ADR_1054). Schemas 1–2 are historical. Hooks name actual entry points; tabletop_gap explicitly blocks paper-playable claims; off_switch means omit overlay without altering CWN or persisted source data. Validation: src/rules/mod_boundary.py and tools/check_mod_activation.py.

gap_fill: Stars Without Number Revised: psionics, whole procedure

mods.name: noosphere_psyche
mods.summary: Noosphere exposure, ontological shock, Psyche instability and recovery
mods.tabletop_gap: no printed procedure for this overlay yet

off_switch.behavior: Do not invoke Noosphere or Psyche methods; preserve existing overlay save data without modifying CWN state.

mods.name: ideology_factions
mods.summary: Discursive identification, faction standings, antagonisms and political temptation
mods.tabletop_gap: no printed procedure for this overlay yet

off_switch.behavior: Bypass optional discourse, ideology and faction reputation presentation; leave CWN reaction and social checks untouched.

mods.name: relationships_reputation
mods.summary: NPC trust, obligations, social capital, institutional standing
mods.tabletop_gap: no printed procedure for this overlay yet

off_switch.behavior: Omit scoped social modifiers and authority overlay; preserve original CWN reaction resolution.

mods.name: investigative_mode
mods.summary: Clue discovery and synthesis; essential clues are never gated behind one failed roll

off_switch.behavior: Do not invoke investigative pools; delegate uncertainty to CWN, without destroying existing investigative save data.

mods.name: vices_temptations
mods.summary: Career ambition, status, trauma, corruption and solidarity as recurring pressures
mods.tabletop_gap: no printed procedure for this overlay yet

off_switch.behavior: No implementation exists; keep inactive and use unchanged CWN procedures.

mods.name: awn_stress
mods.summary: Ashes Without Number Stress, Breakdowns, Hardening and the opt-in addiction submodule
mods.adds: character state only - a Stress meter, consequence codes and the modifiers the table applies; CWN attributes, checks, saves, combat and progression are untouched
mods.tabletop_gap: no printed procedure for this overlay yet

off_switch.behavior: Do not apply Stress events or penalties, and retain CWN WIS, saves and System Strain; do not erase existing Stress save data.

mods.name: goal_tags
mods.summary: One explicit Goal tag per character or faction, with a short/medium/long lifecycle and rewards paid through the existing CWN XP table
mods.adds: narrative state plus CWN experience the campaign chooses to award

off_switch.behavior: Do not instantiate a GoalLog, or set enabled=false: the active list empties, no XP is awarded, and the stored history is preserved untouched. CWN state is never read or written by this mod except through cwn_advancement.level_for_xp().
